A connection message for this chat arrived and ZChat held it back, because this chat\'s security key has not been confirmed. It may be from your contact, or from someone pretending to be them. Compare the safety number with your contact in person or on a channel you already trust: open ⋮ → Verify safety number. Only if the numbers match, tap “Mark as verified”; ZChat then uses the held message, and calls and messages over the relays can start. If they don\'t match, don\'t tap it. Holding the message back cost nothing.

This chat\'s security key was saved before ZChat 2.13 (or brought back by a wallet restore), so ZChat can\'t yet tell whether it is really your contact\'s. The label can go away by itself: after you send a short Shielded message, the next Shielded message your contact writes from ZChat 2.13 or newer removes it (quoted replies do not count). It stays if you or your contact only use Tunnel or Open, if your contact stays on 2.12.4, or if they never write back. Or compare the safety number with your contact in person or on a channel you trust, and tap “Mark as verified” only if the numbers match. Until then, a new relay connection for this chat needs your tap unless the current one approves it. Nothing is paid for this.
